## Type

<!-- Matches the commit-message types in CONTRIBUTING.md. Delete what does not apply. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `perf` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist

<!-- Same list as CONTRIBUTING.md § PR checklist. -->

- [ ] `./gradlew checkAll` passes locally (format + Checkstyle + unit tests)
- [ ] New code has tests
- [ ] Public API changes have Javadoc
- [ ] User-facing changes are reflected in `docs/` and in `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased section)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO — `git commit -s`)
